ADCB Essential Cashback Credit Card -
                 Cashback Eligibility Guide


                 This guide outlines eligible merchant categories on Select category spends for cashback
                 earnings.

                 0.75% Cashback on select spend categories listed below

                 •   Supermarket, Charity, Fuel, Utility, Government, Telecom and Salik
                 •   Transport, Auto dealer, Education, Insurance, Real Estate Agents and Housing Rentals
                 •   Eligible spends at merchants located within the European Union (EU).

                 Important Notes
                 • Bill payments, school fees and transactions made through any ADCB channel are not
                   eligible for cashback. However, such transactions will be included for the purpose of
                   meeting the minimum spend requirement.
                 • Cashback is calculated based on Merchant Category Codes (MCCs) assigned by the
                   merchant’s acquiring bank and card schemes.
                 • Select category spends are identified based on Merchant Category Codes (MCC) assigned
                   by the card network from time to time.

                 ADCB reserves the right to update the list of eligible categories and merchants/service
                 providers at any time.




Ver.01/Jun2026

The Reward Points shall be credited to the Card Account

Guidelines and FAQs on Expedia Vouchers


                      LINK TO REDEEM THE VOUCHER: www.expedia.ae/adcb

                      1.   What are the eligibility criteria to receive welcome voucher of Expedia.ae?
                           The welcome voucher is issued once per customer and is subject to fulfillment of the eligibility
                           criteria outlined below:

                               Traveller Credit Card                                   TouchPoints Infinite Credit Card

                               Payment of the annual fee and a minimum retail          Payment of the annual fee.
                               spend of AED 15,000 must be completed within
                               the first 60 days from the card issuance date.


                      2.   When is the Welcome voucher issued?
                           The voucher will be issued within 60 days of meeting the eligibility criteria outlined above.

                      3.   What are the other associated terms with the Voucher?
                           •      Each voucher is valid for single use only and is subject to the terms and conditions
                                  available on the partner’s website.
                           •      The voucher discount applies to one room per booking and cannot be used for multiple
                                  rooms.
                           •      The discount is applicable solely to base charges (excludes taxes, fees and additional
                                  charges).
                           •      The stay must be booked and completed within the voucher validity period.
                           •      The voucher can be used for bookings at properties worldwide, excluding hotel chains
                                  listed in the exclusion list https://www.expedia.com/lp/b/adcb-hotelexclusion.

                      4.   What are the steps to redeem the voucher code?
                           •      Visit www.expedia.ae/adcb to make your booking. The voucher is valid only on this link
                                  and will not apply to any other Expedia.ae pages.
                           •      Select your preferred hotel (excluding properties or hotel chains listed under the exclusion
                                  list).
                           •      Enter your card details manually (do not use a saved card).
                           •      Enter the complete voucher code (ensure the code is successfully applied) and proceed
                                  with payment.


Ver.01/February2026
                      5.   Can the code be reused if a booking is cancelled by the customer?
                           Yes. If a booking is cancelled by the customer, a new voucher code can be issued. To proceed,
                           we require the details of the original booking details along with the cancellation receipt.

                      6.   Can you extend the voucher validity?
                           The voucher cannot be extended. The voucher is valid for 6 months, providing sufficient time for
                           redemption. Replacement or reissuance of the voucher code is not permitted.

Complimentary airport lounge access

Enjoy 14 complimentary visits to over 1,200 airport lounges worldwide for you and your supplementary cardholders, plus 1 free guest per visit.

To enjoy your complimentary access with your Betaqti Credit Card please follow these steps:

Download the “Mastercard Travel Pass” app at Google Play or App store & register your card before traveling.
Use the app to locate lounges near you and confirm complimentary visits eligibility.
To access a participating lounge present the app QR code to the lounge receptionist.

Please note, supplementary cardholders need to register their card separately on the Mastercard Travel Pass app by following the above process and show their individual QR code.

Keep in mind:

For accompanying guests, over and above the entitlement, an amount of USD 32 per visit will be charged directly to your card.
You enjoy complimentary access for the first two visits after which, a minimum spend of 1 USD or equivalent in non-AED is required to enjoy complimentary access for 3 months from the date of the transaction.
If you do not make an international transaction, you will not be able to access the airport lounge unless you make a payment of USD 32 on your Mastercard card.

For the most updated list of eligible lounges, please click here.

Welcome bonus

Enjoy a Welcome Bonus of Up to 
AED
750 as talabat credit when you sign up for the card via digital channels such as ADCB website, Mobile banking app & Hayakk app.

Important note:
Primary Cardholders not having an existing ADCB Credit Card or ADCB Islamic Credit Card will be eligible for 
AED
750 welcome bonus as talabat credit.
Primary Cardholders having an existing ADCB Credit Card or ADCB Islamic Credit Card will be eligible for 
AED
200 welcome bonus as talabat credit.
The Welcome Bonus is a one-time reward and will be credited to the primary cardholder’s talabat Pay account within 90 days of card issuance and subject to a minimum spend of 
AED
5,000 within 45 days of card issuance.Cancelling your existing talabat card and applying for a new one will make you ineligible for the welcome bonus.
The one-time welcome bonus is only applicable on the first issuance of a talabat ADCB Credit Card. Customers who cancel their card and apply for a new one will not be eligible for the welcome bonus again.

Earn talabat credit on talabat orders & other purchases

Earn talabat credit every time you spend using the card as per below:

35% back as talabat credit on the first 10 talabat orders placed each calendar month. Each order is capped at 
AED
35, with a cumulative limit of 
AED
350 per month. All additional talabat orders within the same month will earn 1.25% as talabat credit. A minimum monthly retail spend of 
AED
2,500 is required to be eligible to earn 35% back as talabat credit on talabat orders. If the minimum spend criteria is not met in any given month, 1.25% back as talabat credit will be applicable to all talabat orders for that particular month.
0.35% back as talabat credit on domestic retail purchases from categories such as fuel, education, government services, real estate, telecommunications, charity, transport, supermarkets, auto dealers, and insurance.
0.35% back as talabat credit on all domestic and international retail purchases made at merchants in the United Kingdom and Europe (i.e., countries that are part of the European Economic Area). The classification of merchants based in the European Economic Area will follow prevailing MasterCard guidelines.
1.25% back as talabat credit on other domestic and international retail purchases, whether made within the UAE or outside the UAE.
Please note: talabat credits are calculated based on the date your purchases are billed on your credit card and not when the transaction was made.
